title: C sos: wire rate-limit + Schnorr48 verify into SOS rx path and register /sos CoAP resource (spec 18.4 R-12-034..041)
description: Remaining slice of l1qw.25: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/sos_alert.c + sos_resource.c exist but sos_ratelimit_check has zero callers and coap_server.c registers no /sos resource. Wire: rx verify (link-layer Schnorr48 before rebroadcast, silent drop on failure per 18.4) -> rate-limit gate (sos_ratelimit_check/record per source IID; 4.29 Too Many Requests with Retry-After on denial) -> rebroadcast-once. Register /sos GET/POST in coap_server.c. Host tests via the SOS cbor/signature vectors. After the ratelimit vector suite (sibling bead) lands.
close_reason: Landed upstream — closing with verification: all components the bead requested are on main. (1) rx verify: link-layer Schnorr48 before rebroadcast with silent drop (sos_origin_verify at coap_server.c, -ENOENT on failure per 18.4); (2) rate-limit gate: sos_ratelimit_check/record wired into the SOS rx path (b493682f32 'feat(coap): sos_ratelimit gate in SOS rx path (R-12-036..038)', plus persistent state fedc948 and iid-buffer/silent-drop reviews 3ab1d902c9); (3) /sos GET+POST registered in coap_server.c (sos_path/sos_attrs resource); (4) the ratelimit vector suite landed as 72e2cfc360 'test(sos): rate-limit vector suite; fix vector arithmetic' with lichen/tests/sos_ratelimit/main.c (194 lines) and test/vectors/sos_rate_limiting.json. Verified: sos_ratelimit_check present in coap_server.c at synced HEAD; lichen-node 337/337 green post-merge.
